notes.title: Post-Launch Bugfixes
notes.notes:
First of all, thanks everyone for supporting the game! I am really happy how the game launched! 

A new version is now on Steam. Some changes and bugfixes include:

 There was a problem with missing pieces especially in level 5. This has been fixed and all the content can now be enjoyed :)
 The minerals are not falling down anymore when the cabinet opens.

Please continue to let me know of any issues!

notes.title: Changes From First Beta Testing Round
notes.notes:
The first beta testing round has finished and these are the changes:

Difficulty lowered a bit
Warning that room-scale is required (on Welcome-Screen)
All walls move continuously now
Moved the helmet UI further away
Added a "Quit" button on the Gameover screen

The changes are already live. Remember, if you want to take part in the playtesting and suggestions phase, please write me and I will send you a key that you can use instantly without waiting for the game to be released.

Thanks to Aerotactics from Reddit for providing his observations!
